altText.TALK_lost_01: A child (around 7) alone and teary beside a market stall, holding an empty ice-cream stick (Lost and found).

altText.TALK_neighbour_01: An older neighbour (new character: woman around 80, headscarf) struggling with two heavy shopping bags at a building door (Helping a neighbour).

altText.TALK_neighbour_10: Last panel — the empty plate returned washed, with a flower on it, at her door (Helping a neighbour).
